environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted' (v1.28 built-in admission). Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockHostPathAndPrivileged' is deployed with match kind Pod across all namespaces except kube-system. The constraint rejects any pod spec containing spec.volumes[].hostPath, spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged=true, or spec.shareProcessNamespace=true. The restricted PSS profile also mandates runAsNonRoot: true, drops ALL capabilities, sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, and requires seccompProfile type RuntimeDefault. Without hostPath, the stateFile/pidFile writes go to ephemeral container storage (no node-level pivot). Without shareProcessNamespace and without KILL/SYS_PTRACE capabilities, no external process can deliver signals to trigger the race. The container runs as UID 65534 (nobody) so even if a signal were somehow delivered, the corrupted state file is container-local and inaccessible to other workloads.

config.network_policy: deny-all-ingress except port 8080 from ingress-controller namespace
